What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Carriers can sometimes experience delays due to limited transportation capacity and high shipping volume, so tracking numbers may take 1 to 2 business days to show online activity, or up to 5 to 8 business days for tracking status updates once picked up.
If you don't see any updates after that time, please let us know so we can look into it and assist you further!

n I reroute the package to a different address?
menu
Once an order has already processed or shipped from our warehouse, we aren't able to make changes to it or reroute the package to a different address.
If the package hasn't arrived yet, you can simply refuse the package upon delivery. Once your online tracking confirms that it is being returned back to us, please let us know right away and we'll be happy to help get an updated order sent out to you!

We don't offer standard compensation or refunds for carrier delivery delays, as shipping timelines can vary due to carrier volume and transportation factors.
However, if your order is significantly delayed beyond our normal handling times, please share your order number and email address with me so we can look into it and assist you!
